More than 32,000 native trees and plants were introduced across 150 acres of damaged land near the Sacramento River. Conservationists have also recorded rare indigo buntings breeding at the site, raising hopes for wildlife recovery.

Since then, the initiative has facilitated 65 loans worth nearly $525,000 and helped create or maintain 150 jobs. A new three-year, $500,000 grant will expand business training and financial support for Latina entrepreneurs.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In 2023, researchers relocated 246 black abalone to a protected coastal site to encourage population growth. After three years, surveys recorded an increase in individuals from 54 to 302, showing signs of recovery. Juvenile abalone were also found, which raises hopes for future reproduction. This project involved collaboration among several scientific organizations and demonstrated the feasibility of habitat restoration. Ongoing monitoring will be crucial to determine the population's long-term sustainability.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a surprising turn of events, a homeowner in Surbiton, London, lost a legal dispute concerning a narrow 48-centimetre strip of land. It was determined that the neighbours' kitchen extension had effectively claimed squatters' rights, having occupied the land uncontested for over two decades. The First-tier Tribunal's decision highlights crucial insights into property borders and emphasizes the importance of diligent title plan checks for prospective buyers to avoid future complications.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Rowan Lowry, a 12-year-old boy, urgently needs a stent procedure to address complications stemming from Kawasaki disease. His family faces an insurance denial categorizing the procedure as medically unnecessary. Undeterred, they plan to seek treatment at Boston Children's Hospital, driven by their concern for Rowan's deteriorating health and the fear of open-heart surgery. Determined, they vow to advocate fiercely for their son's well-being despite the financial strain.

description: In a fascinating twist of fate, Eloise's original portrait, crafted by Hilary Knight in 1956, mysteriously disappeared during a Junior League Ball in 1960. Rediscovered in a dumpster, it lay dormant in Knight's closet for years, only to be brought back to life at a 2017 exhibition at the New-York Historical Society. Its subsequent auction at Bonhams in 2018 for $100,000 underscores the unpredictable journey and enduring value of art.

author: DIPTAYAN HAZRA
description: Ravichandran Ashwin voices his disappointment over Kuldeep Yadav's exclusion from the Indian cricket team, arguing that a single bowler shouldn't bear the brunt of criticism when conditions are tough. He predicts that Varun Chakravarthy may be favored for the New Zealand series instead of Kuldeep. Ashwin raises concerns about India prioritizing batting strength over specialized bowlers, stressing the importance of having real wicket-takers if four seamers are in play.
title: ‘Unfair’ treatment of Kuldeep Yadav? Ashwin fears another benching on NZ tour

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: LouLou, a poodle-husky mix, was found after being lost for more than 50 hours in Alaska. Her owners, who were overseas, coordinated a search utilizing local volunteers and technology. An Apple AirTag played a crucial role in narrowing down her location. After being located, LouLou was airlifted to safety and examined by veterinarians. The reunion marked a successful rescue effort due to the dedication of many individuals involved.
title: Dog survives 50 hours alone after Alaska avalanche

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Canadian billionaire and Shark Tank judge Kevin O’Leary has said he no longer believes engineering is the only education worth pursuing. In a post on X, O’Leary argued that storytelling, photography, video editing and content creation have become highly lucrative skills, with creators earning from contracts with multiple companies by helping brands lower customer acquisition costs and improve returns on advertising spend.
title: Shark Tank’s Kevin O’Leary: Engineering is no longer the only education worth getting

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Vanessa Romano launched Little Party Co. with just a $500 investment in outdoor party games, inspired by social media trends. Within a few months, her savvy approach catapulted her revenue to over $9,000. She strategically reinvested her profits while balancing a full-time corporate career and family. Rather than abandoning her corporate job, Romano embraces both roles, demonstrating that entrepreneurship can flourish without choosing between them.
title: Mom turns $500 and 4 yard games into $9K side hustle

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: The Pakistan Cricket Board has announced a commentary panel of six for the upcoming men's ODI tri-series. Notably, renowned commentators Michael Atherton and Nasser Hussain will be missing after a controversial interview on Imran Khan's prison health caused a stir. The matches between Pakistan, England, and Sri Lanka will take place from October 18 to October 31, with coverage from former international players at venues in Rawalpindi and Lahore.
title: PCB snubs Michael Atherton, Nasser Hussain after Imran Khan interview controversy

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Astronomers have discovered an intriguing white dwarf star designated WD J1330+6435, nestled within the Draco constellation. Its striking green hue arises from the interaction of sodium and helium particles in its atmosphere. This celestial body lies about 280 light-years from Earth, presenting itself as it was 280 years ago. With a surface temperature nearing 4,000 degrees Celsius, its dimensions are comparable to that of our planet.
title: Astronomers discover green star 280 light-years away; what makes it glow green

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: China's CXMT has sent global memory chip stocks tumbling after claiming key progress on a denser 4F² DRAM design and plans for a server memory module by the end of 2026. Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung have lost billions in market value as investors question how long AI-driven memory profits can last. Here is what CXMT announced, why it matters and what analysts make of the threat.
title: What is CXMT's 'Chinese chip bomb' that has wiped billions off the US stock market

author: etimes.in
description: Ajay Devgn's 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' saw a 61.3% increase in box office collections on its third Saturday. The movie earned Rs 5 crore on Day 16, improving its cumulative domestic net collection to Rs 341.10 crore. Its worldwide gross collection reached Rs 528.77 crore, with domestic and overseas contributions. The film, which continues the story from its predecessor, features an ensemble cast including Tabu and Shriya Saran.
title: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' box office collection day 16: Film crosses Rs 500cr

author: VIVEK DUBEY
description: A tragic accident occurred in Gwalior where a truck lost control and hit devotees waiting by a temple. Thirteen individuals lost their lives in the incident that took place in the early hours of Sunday. Nearly 40 others sustained injuries, with several reported to be in serious condition. Police and rescue teams are working to assist the injured at the scene.
title: 12 killed after speeding truck runs over devotees near temple in Gwalior

author: MURARI SHETYE
description: Goa police registered an FIR against 300 unidentified protesters involved in a Cockroach Janata Party protest. The protesters allegedly raised slogans that hurt Hindu sentiments, promoting religious disharmony. Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that the government would not tolerate disturbances to communal harmony in the state. A resident filed the complaint after viewing a video of the protest circulated on social media.
title: CJP protest: Police file FIR against 300 for anti-Hindutva slogans

author: TAMAGHNA BANERJEE
description: Chetla Agrani's organisers quickly acted to prevent a possible crowd surge after an earlier disaster in Chorbagan. Other popular Durga Puja spots like Tala Prattoy and College Square also halted entry as a precaution. Organisers across these venues are reassessing crowd management strategies to enhance safety and prevent similar incidents. Some pujas reduced celebratory activities in response to the nearby tragedies, demonstrating a commitment to public safety.
title: 4 major pujas across Kolkata shut down as gloom overshadows festive mood

author: SUGANDHA JHA
description: Several students at Jamia Millia Islamia have begun a hunger strike, calling for the revival of student union elections. Tensions escalated when security allegedly removed them from the campus. As a result, the university has suspended and rusticated some of the involved students. Protesters are demanding the chief proctor's resignation and a thorough independent inquiry into the incident, while university authorities argue that student representation continues through alternative electoral frameworks.
title: Jamia protesters ‘dragged’ out of campus, rusticated; university says ‘self defence’
